suites.name: integration
expected_test_titles: pa11y-ci (with a single erroring URL) exits with 2
pa11y-ci (with a single erroring URL) outputs a result notice for each URL
pa11y-ci (with a single erroring URL) outputs error information
pa11y-ci (with a single erroring URL) outputs a total erroring notice
pa11y-ci (with multiple erroring URLs) exits with 2
pa11y-ci (with multiple erroring URLs) outputs a result notice for each URL
pa11y-ci (with multiple erroring URLs) outputs error information
pa11y-ci (with multiple erroring URLs) outputs a total erroring notice
pa11y-ci (with an erroring URL and a CLI threshold of 1) retains the execution error and exits with 2
pa11y-ci (with an erroring URL and a CLI threshold of 100) retains the execution error and exits with 2
pa11y-ci (with multiple erroring URLs and a CLI threshold of 100) attempts both pages, retains their execution errors and exits with 2
pa11y-ci (with an erroring URL and positive page and CLI thresholds) does not let either threshold excuse the failed execution
pa11y-ci (with the `--json` flag set) exits with 2 when execution fails even with accessibility errors below the CLI threshold
pa11y-ci (with the `--json` flag set) outputs the results as JSON
pa11y-ci (with JSON output for a passing URL) exits with 0 and reports zero failed executions
expected_failed_titles: pa11y-ci (with an erroring URL and a CLI threshold of 1) retains the execution error and exits with 2
pa11y-ci (with an erroring URL and a CLI threshold of 100) retains the execution error and exits with 2
pa11y-ci (with multiple erroring URLs and a CLI threshold of 100) attempts both pages, retains their execution errors and exits with 2
pa11y-ci (with an erroring URL and positive page and CLI thresholds) does not let either threshold excuse the failed execution
pa11y-ci (with the `--json` flag set) exits with 2 when execution fails even with accessibility errors below the CLI threshold
pa11y-ci (with the `--json` flag set) outputs the results as JSON
pa11y-ci (with JSON output for a passing URL) exits with 0 and reports zero failed executions
